scanner.implementation: compact scanner, Explore renderer, and broadcast FM are enabled by the Scan pack

explore-engine.implementation: Explore-only scanner engine API; Base retains the fixed API slots with unavailable stubs.

explore-ui.implementation: Explore-only renderer and frame callbacks; Base retains the fixed API slots with unavailable stubs.

candidate-ranking.implementation: candidate-ranking callbacks have stable unavailable stubs outside Scan

cw-tone-observation.implementation: Shared CW decode and managed tone-observation APIs are linked only with Scan; Base keeps stable fail-closed API stubs.

fsk-rx.implementation: Optional raw fixed-frame FSK RX and TX; stable unavailable stubs outside Data. Software APRS / AFSK TX are independent.

sotto-decoder.implementation: Voice pager and fixed-point decoder are linked only when K6_SOTTO_SERVICE=1; Base keeps the module queue and omits the legacy pager path.

designer.implementation: experimental SPI theme reader and renderer; production installation pending

ota.implementation: SipHash and RF module ingress; Base uses cable-only CRC32 envelopes.
